PC1_sensitivity.why: shipped non-injective idempotent self-map with a C peer; if the orbit instrument cannot see it, it is blind

PC2_specificity.why: order reversal is an involution, hence a bijection

PC3_v1_refutation_rerun.why: this control FIRED against census instrument v1 (SEMIGROUP on carrier=Z12, binding b=12 n=6 -- a modulus SMALLER than the enumerated carrier). Orbit closure chooses no window, so it must now pass. If it fires again, M3's Tier-B numbers are VOID.

PC4_non_vacuity.rule: both GROUP and SEMIGROUP buckets non-empty

PC5_oracle_separation.rule: oracle must rescue >= 1 ladder-NOT_EXECUTABLE op AND must fail to rescue srmech.amsc.format.sha256_bytes (bytes -> str, genuinely not a self-map)
PC5_oracle_separation.why: an oracle that rescues everything, or nothing, cannot separate. rc428's D1 shipped controls that were computed and never read.

PC6_reproduction.rule: rc427 partition reproduces at rc429 up to the 649 -> 655 delta

PC7_classifier_residual.rule: UNCLASSIFIED < 20% of the unreachable set, else M2 is UNSUPPORTED

PC8_guard_extractor_recall.rule: the THREE ops the rc430 brief names by their raises must each be found with a DOMAIN guard on the named parameter
PC8_guard_extractor_recall.why: the first draft found only two of three. cyclic_mod_add is a thin DELEGATING wrapper whose guard lives in srmech.math.cyclic.mod_add, one call level down. An extractor that does not follow delegation reports NO_DOMAIN_GUARD for it -- and for 132 other ops. If this control fails, M4's NO_DOMAIN_GUARD count is an OVER-count and M4 is reported BOUNDED rather than as a cardinal.

PC9_harness_integrity.rule: WORKER_DIED + WORKER_RESTART + TIMEOUT must be < 1/20 of the probe set, else M3 is VOID
PC9_harness_integrity.why: MEASURED, not hypothetical. One run of this file recorded WORKER_DIED on 251 of 533 probes -- the worker script had been deleted out from under the live job -- and it still exited 0 with PC1 through PC8 ALL PASSING, because every named control op happened to be probed before the cascade. A control set that a half-dead run satisfies is not a control set. The worker now lives in a private temp dir under a PID-unique name so nothing in the tree can collide with it, and this falsifier makes the failure loud instead of arithmetic.

note: the ladder and the oracle are NOT nested instruments

atom_rule: a boolean guard is split into ATOMS; 'a < 0 or b < 0' is TWO independent single-param constraints, not a relation. An isinstance/type atom re-states the ALREADY-published type and is not counted as a domain constraint.
question: is the constraint DERIVABLE from guards already in the code?

caveat: rc427 L3 stands: returns= can lie. A disagreement is not by itself a declared-type defect -- a dtype-polymorphic return or a widened `object` reads the same way.
question: can returns.type x parameters[].type, both shipped TODAY, predict the NOT_ENDO class the census can never reach?

assumptions.A1: the field supplies a valid argument wherever one exists, so the NO_VALID_ARG_RECOVERED ops resolve at the rate observed on the ops that had one
assumptions.A2: the field additionally lets a consumer ENUMERATE the domain, so every VACUOUS (|S| < 2, single seed) verdict gains a 2nd element
assumptions.A3: NOT_ENDO converts at ZERO under every assumption -- a constraint on an INPUT parameter cannot change what type an op RETURNS

PC5.rule: rescues >=1 ladder-NOT_EXECUTABLE AND fails on sha256_bytes

PC8.rule: the three brief-named ops each yield a DOMAIN guard

PC9.rule: harness breakage < 1/20 of the probe set

limits.O1: positives CONFIRMED, negatives BOUNDED (orbit of THESE seeds)
limits.O2: identity is sha256(type+repr); address-bearing reprs -> ORBIT_UNCLOSED
limits.O3: the WHY-classifier is a regex, cross-checked against the oracle
limits.O4: the oracle is a LOWER bound on valid-argument availability
limits.O5: snippet execution has side effects; temp cwd + killable worker
